City of Encinitas
Planning Commission
AGENDA
SEPTEMBER 17, 2020 -
06:00 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
Items 6B and 8A are located within the Coastal Zone and require the issuance of a Coastal Development Permit (CDP). The action of the Planning Commission or City Council relative to Items 6B and 8A may not be appealed to the California Coastal Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. If at least two (2) Planning Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
5.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act (open meetings for local bodies, California Government Code Section 54950 et seq.).
6.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless
an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by
submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Commissioner or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
6A.
PROJECT NAME: TPM 16-094; CASE NUMBER: 16-094 TPM; APPLICANT: James Engert; LOCATION: 1326 Berryman Canyon Road; DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to consider approval of the recordation of the Parcel Map which has been reviewed and found to be consistent with the Tentative Parcel Map (Case No. 16-094 TPM/MINMOD/CDP); ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project has been determined to be exempt from environmental review pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines.
STAFF CONTACT: Jesse Owens, Associate Engineer: (760) 633-2780 or jowens@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends approval.
Engert Residence Case #16-094 TPM, MINMOD, CDP1326 Berryman Canyon Road
6B.
PROJECT NAME: Berryman Canyon (Lot 2); CASE NUMBER: CDP-003495-2019; FILING DATE: December 12, 2019 APPLICANT: Addison Walker; LOCATION: Berryman Canyon (APN 262-080-43); PROJECT DESCRIPTION: A Coastal Development Permit to construct a new single-family residence with site improvements on a vacant lot.. ZONING/OVERLAY: The project site is located within the Residential 3 (R-3) Zone, Hillside/Inland Bluff Overlay Zone and the Coastal Overlay Zone.; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project has been determined to be exempt from environmental review pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15303(a). Section 15303(a) exempts the construction of a new single-family residence.
STAFF CONTACT: J. Dichoso, Associate Planner: (760) 633-2681 or jdichoso@encinitasca.gov
Staff item be continued to October 1, 2020.
Berryman Canyon Residence (Lot 2) Case #3495-2019 CDP
7.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
8.
REGULAR AGENDA - ACTION ITEMS
8A.
PROJECT NAME: Simkin Residence; CASE NUMBER: MULTI-003643-2020; DR-003642-2020; CDPNF-003644-2020; FILING DATE: March 2, 2020; APPLICANT: Samuel and Carol Simkin; LOCATION: 1435 Bella Azul Court (APN 216-122-46-00); PROJECT DESCRIPTION: A Design Review Permit and Coastal Development Permit for the construction of a new single-family residence on an existing vacant lot. ZONING/OVERLAY: The project site is located within the Rural Residential1 (RR-1) Zone, Hillside/Inland Bluff Overlay Zone and the Coastal Overlay Zone.; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project has been determined to be exempt from environmental review pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15303(a). Section 15303(a) exempts the construction of a new single-family residence.
STAFF CONTACT: Andrew Maynard, Associate Planner: (760) 633-2718 or amaynard@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends approval.
Simkin Residence Case #MULTI-3643-2020 1435 Bella Azul Court

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY PLANNING COMMISSIONERS
